title: ActivationConfig
description:
The activation document: the state a client authors for one active charter (ADR-0020 D4). It is the body of PUT /activations/{activationId} and POST /activations and the config of every Activation answer. Core keeps its own files and maps them to and from this document (content alignment, not file shape).

Three states: for activatedKinds, missionTypes, languages and each selected kind, an absent member takes its default, [] is empty and a list is that set; null is never a value. missionTypes is the exception in meaning, not in form: absent and [] both mean no mission type is in force, and the two stay distinct on the wire so a fetched document registers unchanged.

Canonical form, which the service stores and answers: ids in their declared spelling; id and token lists deduplicated and sorted, except packs, which keeps merge order; an empty selected or deactivated object left out, while selected.<kind>: [] is kept; lists sorted by Unicode code point; members in the order of this schema. An empty deny list is refused (422), never stored. The activation's revision is sha256: and the hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization of the canonical document.

Not in the document, by ruling (2026-10-31): per-entry provenance, context activations and applied presets. Not stored because the packs derive it: the required floor, locked artifacts, the available artifacts and the skipped report.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this document's shape: 1.

packs.description: The packs the activation builds on, in merge order: a later pack wins over an earlier one. Absent means the service's configured offering. A pack id appears once (422 activation_invalid otherwise).

activatedKinds.description: The kinds in force. Absent means every kind; [] means none.

missionTypes.description: The mission types in force, by id. Absent and [] both mean none: a mission type is never in force by default. Kept distinct on the wire.

selected.description: The allow lists, per kind. Absent means every kind takes its default.

deactivated.description: The deny lists, per kind. Absent means no exclusion.

languages.description: The project's languages, as authored; languages core derives are not sent. Absent means no language filter; [] means no language.

ActivatableKind.title: ActivatableKind
ActivatableKind.description: An artifact kind an activation selects or deactivates: every artifact kind of NodeKind except template and asset, which are never activated, and mission_type, which ActivationConfig.missionTypes holds. The snake_case token of ArtifactKind.

ArtifactId.title: ArtifactId
ArtifactId.description: An artifact's declared id, the tail of its URN (directive:DIRECTIVE_001 has the id DIRECTIVE_001). A write may use another known spelling of the same artifact; the stored document holds the declared id (ADR-0020 D4).

ArtifactIdList.title: ArtifactIdList
ArtifactIdList.description: Artifact ids of one kind. Empty means none of the kind.

DeactivatedArtifacts.title: DeactivatedArtifacts
DeactivatedArtifacts.description: The deny lists: per activatable kind, the artifacts the user deactivated (ADR-0013). A deny entry wins over a selection and a cascade; an artifact a pack requires or locks cannot be deactivated (409). A deny entry is never stored for an unknown kind or a required or locked id (ADR-0020 D9). Absent, the activation excludes nothing.

directive.description: The directive ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

tactic.description: The tactic ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

styleguide.description: The styleguide ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

toolguide.description: The toolguide ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

paradigm.description: The paradigm ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

procedure.description: The procedure ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

agent_profile.description: The agent_profile ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

mission_step_contract.description: The mission_step_contract ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

glossary_pack.description: The glossary_pack ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

skill.description: The skill ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

anti_pattern.description: The anti_pattern ids. Absent means no exclusion of the kind.

DeniedArtifactIdList.title: DeniedArtifactIdList
DeniedArtifactIdList.description: The deactivated ids of one kind. Never empty: a kind with no deny entry is left out of the deny list.

LanguageToken.title: LanguageToken
LanguageToken.description: A programming language as the project authored it, lower case, for example java or c#.

PackPin.title: PackPin
PackPin.description: One pack the activation builds on (ADR-0033 D6).

packId.description: The pack's id, as the service's pack registry names it.

version.description: The pack version the activation builds on, as the pack declares it (pack_version). Absent means the version the service holds; with several versions held side by side, the newest (ADR-0033 D7).

SelectedArtifacts.title: SelectedArtifacts
SelectedArtifacts.description: The allow lists: per activatable kind, the artifacts the activation selects. A kind that is absent takes its default: every artifact of the kind, except skill, whose default is only the required skills. One property per ActivatableKind, so a kind outside that vocabulary is refused (422 activation_invalid).

directive.description: The directive ids. Absent means every artifact of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

tactic.description: The tactic ids. Absent means every artifact of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

styleguide.description: The styleguide ids. Absent means every artifact of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

toolguide.description: The toolguide ids. Absent means every artifact of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

paradigm.description: The paradigm ids. Absent means every artifact of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

procedure.description: The procedure ids. Absent means every artifact of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

agent_profile.description: The agent_profile ids. Absent means every artifact of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

mission_step_contract.description: The mission_step_contract ids. Absent means every artifact of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

glossary_pack.description: The glossary_pack ids. Absent means every artifact of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

skill.description: The skill ids. Absent means only the required skills (the must-have items of the governing presets, ADR-0031), not every skill; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

anti_pattern.description: The anti_pattern ids. Absent means every artifact of the kind; [] means none; a list means exactly those.

Slug.title: Slug
Slug.description: A lowercase identifier segment of a DRG URN.
